data.one_liner: Detects if your iOS app is running on an Apple Silicon Mac or visionOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that leverages native Apple APIs to check whether an iOS app is running on an Apple Silicon Mac or visionOS.
use_when: You need to adjust UI or features for iOS apps running on macOS or visionOS.
You want to detect Apple Silicon Mac deployment for iOS targets.
avoid_when: You are building a standard macOS desktop app using Mac Catalyst.
You only need general device information and can use a broader device info package instead.
strengths: Provides specific detection for iOS apps running on non-iOS Apple platforms.
Simple static methods for easy usage.
weaknesses: Limited to specific Apple platform use cases.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS 14.0 or later for isiOSAppOnMac and iOS 26.1 or later for isiOSAppOnVision.

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides comprehensive hardware and OS information across multiple platforms rather than just specific iOS-on-Mac checks.
